label: Whatever team you land on
title: We have more.
intro: Across every team, you get the same culture — competitive where it counts, human everywhere else.

perks.title: Breaks are fine
perks.body: Going away or need time off? Perhaps just a little burnt out? Life is important too — let us know in advance if you need to take a break!

perks.title: Real coordination
perks.body: Strategy is planned, plans are made, making sure no one is confused on what to do. You'll always know the goal before an event starts.

perks.title: A community that helps
perks.body: Strats, solutions, or just someone to play with — people are here to help you succeed. We will assist and create a healthy and enjoyable environment for all.

perks.title: Zero toxicity, zero elitism
perks.body: We take the game seriously, but remember: others are learning. We respect mastery but do not allow elitism.

perks.title: No hardcore grinding required
perks.body: Just use your tickets and set decent scores. We value your time and don't require you to be online 24/7.

perks.title: Boss Rush for everyone
perks.body: We also play Boss Rush on our lower teams. Don't want to play and just get rewards? No problem — you can leave your team to grab rewards, and go back.

perks.title: More than just BTD6
perks.body: Regular server events including Minecraft, skribbl.io, and more for server-wide fun!

perks.title: Room to grow
perks.body: Start wherever suits you and climb at your own pace. The structure is there — your dedication drives it.
